_about: Replay seed for the Feature 2 simulation (memory-architecture.md, section 1). Summaries are written from the repo files named in source_path; the repo wins if they disagree. as_of for the replay is 2026-11-12 (Feature 2 spec v1.0 baselined). Dates are the dates the sources give. Where a source gives no date, the earliest dated Feature 1 record (2026-11-11) is used and the record says so in `note`.

records.summary: A booked job occupies [start, end + 45 min) for its technician. The next job may start exactly at the buffered end. Both buffered intervals are compared, so inserting a job before an existing one also respects travel time.

records.note: The source gives no date; 2026-11-11 is the earliest dated Feature 1 record.
records.summary: The standard travel buffer per job is 45 minutes (TRAVEL_BUFFER_MINUTES in TechnicianAvailabilityService). It limits how many jobs fit in a technician's day.
Superseded: the original overlap check rejected a booking only when its start time exactly matched an existing booking's start time. It did not compare intervals.

records.note: The source gives no date; 2026-11-11 is the date BUG-001 was verified.
records.summary: Booking-conflict detection must compare time intervals for the same technician, keep TRAVEL_BUFFER_MINUTES = 45, reject conflicts with HTTP 409 and an ApiError body, and never persist a rejected booking.

records.note: The source gives no date; 2026-11-11 is the earliest dated Feature 1 record.
records.summary: Backend convention: REST endpoints return ResponseEntity<T>. Validation errors return 400 and not-found returns 404, each with an ApiError body.
BUG-001: the booking overlap check compared only exact start times. Fixed with a buffered interval check [start, end + 45 min). Verified 2026-11-11. Concurrent-booking atomicity was out of scope.
BUG-002: a job is accepted with an end time at or before its start time, because nothing on the booking path checks the range. Reported 2026-11-12; fix proposed, awaiting a human decision.
BUG-003: validation failures return Spring's default 400 body, not an ApiError, because there is no global exception handler. Reported 2026-11-12 and not yet fixed.
BUG-004: completed and cancelled jobs still block a technician's calendar. It is a requirement gap routed to the BA, with no fix until the policy is settled.
Feature 2: a reservation can only target a job whose status is SCHEDULED, and it never creates, moves or alters that job's booked slot.
ADR-001: serialise stock changes with one lock around check-and-apply and the stock read. Safe for a single instance only.
Seeded parts catalogue: five parts, ids 1 to 5, with available stock 12, 25, 6, 3 and 0.
Every 4xx response must carry an ApiError body. Request-level 400 mapping lives in one shared handler; new 404 and 409 outcomes use their own exception types, mapped centrally.
Standard travel buffer per job is 90 minutes. A booked job occupies [start, end + 90 min).
